help.definition: What you need from somebody else. You can need help with a task, a feeling or a person.
help.example: I need some help with this.

proving.definition: The resting time when the dough grows bigger because of the yeast.
proving.example: The dough is proving now, so it will be ready in an hour.

psy_coercion.definition: The removal of a real choice by force or by the threat of harm.
psy_coercion.example: Sign the form today or lose the job — that is coercion, not persuasion.

towel.definition: A soft cloth. You use it to dry your body, your hair and your hands.
towel.example: The blue towel is warm and dry.

war_morale.definition: The spirit and the confidence of a force; the strength it holds when things go badly.
war_morale.example: Morale fell as the third convoy did not arrive.

wh_anode_rod.definition: A rod of metal that corrodes instead of the tank, so that the tank wall is saved.
wh_anode_rod.example: The anode rod is checked at every service and replaced when it is worn away.
